item.title: e-up

item.title: Phone Holder

item.title: Partify
item.description: Automotive body panel supplier based in Fraser, Michigan, specializing in painted body panels. Partify offers a wide selection of high-quality aftermarket parts for vehicles,

item.title: carget
item.description: Carget is a network of used car dealerships located in various regions, including Woodbridge, VA; Saskatoon, SK, Canada; San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo Leon, Mexico; and West Milwaukee, WI.

item.title: Ohme
item.description: Company specializing in engineering smart home chargers for electric vehicles. Their technology integrates with all energy tariffs, allowing drivers to charge their vehicles at the cheapest and greenest times available,

item.title: Thinkcar
item.description: Company specializing in automotive diagnostic tools designed to read and clear diagnostic trouble codes, view live data, and perform system tests and maintenance functions.

item.title: Rapido

item.title: Tire Discounters
item.description: Tire Discounters is a tire and auto service shop founded by Chip Wood in 1976 in Cincinnati, Ohio. It has grown to become the eighth-largest independent tire dealer in the U.S., offering a wide range of tire brands and automotive services,

item.title: Moove
